purpose: Two genuinely-fetched BFS STATPOP json-stat2 responses captured during Phase-0 source reconnaissance, before the pxweb POST endpoint began rate-limiting. They are committed so the two headline BFS views (the 2010-2024 trend and the citizenship-vs-birthplace split) are always available and reproducible without a live pxweb query. These are REAL fetched values with real provenance, not synthesised. scripts/harvest.ts loads them via runBfsSeed() and also attempts the fuller live queries; when pxweb is reachable the live harvest supersedes/augments these with the deeper breakdowns.

responses.yields: Chilean-born residents of Zug by passport group, 2024
